notes: - The headless UI check drives the portfolio views, whose rail items only render once a portfolio exists — true on any machine that has used Orrery, false on a fresh CI runner, so the check's very first CI run failed on "rail item missing". The test now **seeds a throwaway portfolio through the real code path** when no store is provided, and explicitly selects it before driving the views. Failure output from the UI harness now surfaces the actual error line instead of the last three lines of a stack trace.
